lines.zh: 扑棱着鳍片，像只滑稽的鸭子！
lines.en: Flapping fins, like a silly duck!
Can be caught in a bucket!
Can be tamed with tropical fish!

lines.zh: 慢吞吞地在地面上行走！
像鱼又像鸟的奇怪生物！
肚皮贴地，一蹭一蹭地挪。
lines.en: Belly to the ground, I scoot along.
My funnellike mouth roots through mud.
I drift down slow, like a chicken.
However far I fall, it never hurts.
Muddy water slides off my fins.

lines.zh: 红树林的根间我钻来钻去。

lines.en: Can breed variants when full health!

lines.zh: 背着箱子，装满捡来的东西。
lines.en: Chest on my back, full of picked-up things.
The sweater itches, but it's warm.

lines.zh: 晒着太阳，鳍片慢慢张开。
lines.en: In the sun, my fins slowly spread.
I roll in the mud. Comfortable.
Staring at the player for a while!
Can’t take eyes off the player!
Is that a tropical fish in your hand?
Don't look at me with a sword. I get scared.

lines.zh: 你袖口有热带鱼的腥味。
lines.en: Your sleeve smells of tropical fish.
Walk slower. I can't keep up.
The floor feels a bit soft...
Why is the floor so hard...

lines.zh: 看着美味的虫子，你都快流口水了。
lines.en: You're tempted by the tasty bugs.

lines.zh: 这片草地看起来多诱人啊！
这桶水里肯定有好东西。
lines.en: That bucket has got to have something.

lines.zh: 热带鱼似乎很受欢迎啊。
lines.en: The tropical fish are clearly popular.

lines.zh: 我闻到新鲜食物的味道了。
这堆掉落物中有什么好东西。
lines.en: There's got to be something good here.

lines.zh: 这些食物看起来很美味。
我在地上找到了一块肉。
lines.en: I found some meat on the ground.

lines.zh: 这些树叶可能能做点什么。

lines.en: That bucket of water, I could fit inside.

lines.zh: 角落里掉了东西，我看见了。
lines.en: Something dropped in the corner. I saw it.
That fishy smell. I know it.
Can I eat what's in your hand?

lines.zh: 别撞我！你走路不看路吗？
lines.en: Don't bump into me! Can't you see where you're going?

lines.zh: 我可不想和你撞个满怀。
lines.en: I don't want to collide with you.
Be careful, don't knock me over.
Move! I'm going to bump into you.
I warn you not to bump into me.
It's important to find a mate.
Sweater's on — now down to business.
I'm ready to mate with you.

lines.zh: 这东西我塞进胸口的箱子。
lines.en: I stuff this into the chest on my back.

lines.zh: 这枚贝壳，我用嘴拱进箱子。
lines.en: I shovel this shell into my chest with my mouth.

lines.zh: 我贴着肚皮，挪到你的脚边。
lines.en: Belly to the ground, I shuffle to your feet.

lines.zh: 那边有亮闪闪的掉落物。
我压低肚皮，一点点挪过去。
lines.en: I flatten my belly and scoot over inch by inch.
I scoot along the mud without a sound.
Belly to the ground, and locked on you.
Wait till I scoot over. Don't take it.

lines.zh: 发出咯吱声，试图用扁平身躯撞翻你。
lines.en: Squeaks, trying to knock you over with its flat body.

lines.zh: 笨拙地贴着肚皮游来游去，攻击你。
lines.en: Slowly flops along belly-first, attempting to attack you.

lines.zh: 发出咔哒声，用头部撞击你。

lines.en: Opens mouth, trying to bite you.

lines.zh: 扁平的身体撞向你，试图压倒你。
lines.en: Flat body slams into you, trying to knock you down.

lines.zh: 贴着地面，笨拙地移动，然后试图踢你。
lines.en: Moves on its belly, clumsily, then tries to kick you.

lines.zh: 用扁平的身体撞你，试图将你压倒。
lines.en: Uses its flat body to slam you, trying to knock you down.

lines.zh: 发出咂咂声，试图用扁平的身体撞翻你。
lines.en: Makes a smacking sound, trying to knock you over with its flat body.

lines.zh: 用扁平的身体撞向你，试图将你压倒。
lines.en: Slams its flat body into you, trying to knock you down.

lines.zh: 发出咔哒声，试图用头部撞倒你。
lines.en: Clicks, trying to knock you down with its head.
Slides out from the mangrove swamp.
Crawls out from the swamp mud.
Swims in the water, looking for food.

lines.zh: 在泥泞中移动，寻找食物。
lines.en: Moves in the mud, looking for food.
Slowly swims at the bottom of the water.
Searches for food in the mud.

lines.zh: 箭扎进鳍边，我翻了个身。
lines.en: An arrow pierced my fin and flipped me over.

lines.zh: 箱子空了，我连泥都想啃。
lines.en: My chest is empty; I would chew mud.

lines.zh: 雷打在背上，毛衣都焦了。
lines.en: Lightning hit my back and singed my sweater.
